view_title: ฐานราก F1, F2, F3 (แปลนขยาย + รูปตัด), หน้าตัดเสา C1, C2, C3
views: view1: แปลนฐานราก, คานคอดิน, คาน ค.ส.ล., ตง, พื้น 1:100 — footing_plan
view3: แปลนคาน โครงหลังคา 1:100 — roof_frame_plan
view4: beam sections G1-G3, B1-B11, slab S1, แบบพื้นคอนกรีตติดดิน — section
view5: ฐานราก F1/F2/F3 (plan + section) and column sections C1/C2/C3 — section
view6: ข้อกำหนดเข็ม + หมายเหตุ (handwritten) — notes
warnings: Footings: plan sizes from the printed edge/pile-spacing chains (kept in *_printed_as); thickness from the section chain 0.10 (sloped top) + 0.30 / 0.20 (edge); lean concrete 1:3:5 0.10 and compacted sand 0.10 below; the 1.20 depth line runs from ระดับดินเดิม to the footing underside.

F1 and F3 print two different mat spacings (Ø9 @0.12 and Ø9 @0.08) for the two directions without saying which is which; spacing_mm takes the closer one and both are kept in printed_as/note. No bar count is printed, so main_bar has no count (section 6b).

Piles: hollow hexagonal concrete pile 0.15 x 6.00 (12 / 5 / 9 per F1 / F2 / F3); the pile substitution note (ข้อกำหนดเข็ม) is kept as pile.alternate_printed_as. Sheet 1 (หน้า02) prints a different footing set for prestressed piles under the same marks — kept in its own file.

Columns: one entry per level (section 8). C1/C3 below and above the ground floor, C2 footing to stage floor only (its plan note says the hall C2 run up to the ground-beam level). Ties marked คู่ (double) are noted on the stirrup.
